# Incident Response Partial Procedure

Organization: Example GmbH
Version: 0.8 draft
Review date: May 2026
Document owner: Operations Manager role

## Current Procedure

The incident response workflow describes intake, triage, containment, and customer
communication. The response team keeps an incident log and assigns an owner for each
security incident.

## Gap

The incident reporting timeline is not defined. The draft does not state a 24 hours or
72 hours reporting expectation, and regulator escalation remains planned only.
